title: If I make a game in astra, can I send it to Unreal Engine?
author: That_Character2690

replies.author: That_Character2690
replies.body: Is this feasible with a boxing game - similar mechanics and style to the Undisputed boxing game series? (I’m new to game dev, sorry)

replies.author: TopTippityTop
replies.body: Unreal is more challenging than other engines, and it's a bit more geared to FPS, but you can do whatever you'd like.

comments.author: lemonlemons
comments.body: This is what I made with Astra using UE today: [https://x.com/randomi777/status/2098542513707430228](https://x.com/randomi777/status/2098542513707430228)

replies.author: TopTippityTop
replies.body: What reasoning effort? Did you use any particular skills?

replies.author: lemonlemons
replies.body:
high reasoning. I used dream-loop skill: [https://github.com/achimala/dream-loop](https://github.com/achimala/dream-loop)

It eats a lot of tokens but helps with the visuals quite a bit

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: Do you think I can leave something like this on an already made project like if I wanted it to improve the graphics?

replies.author: lemonlemons
replies.body: Pretty sure you can. This is actually result of multiple dream-loop runs. The first run looked bit meh but I kept asking Astra to improve it until I ran out of usage and this is where it got. Need to continue once I get more usage..

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: I was trying astra for the first time and I quickly hit my limit, I'm assuming you're using like a major plan then because I feel like I wouldn't be able to get very far

replies.author: lemonlemons
replies.body: I have 5x Pro subscription.. Need to upgrade to 20x once they open them again, Astra is too much fun!

replies.author: derAres
replies.body: May I ask: where did astra get the assets? Trees, grass, all of it…?

replies.author: lemonlemons
replies.body: It modeled all the assets with Blendsr

replies.author: gravlane-srr
replies.body: Does it contain any music or sounds?

replies.author: lemonlemons
replies.body: I didn’t ask Astra to create sounds yet but it actually did create sword swoosh sound already..

comments.author: RoryOS
comments.body: Develop the game you want to make in the engine you want to use.

comments.author: StrongCucumber
comments.body: Yes you can use Astra to make a game in Unreal Engine... if it was your question

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body: You have to make it in Unreal using MCP, with Astra

comments.author: reality_comes
comments.body: With Astra in unreal engine,  yes

comments.author: thebuddybud
comments.body:
Most of you guys dont seem to understand what game development consists of, and what these Ai tools are capable of.   

Yes, you can use astra with unreal engine, or other game dev engines, with the proper set up.

comments.author: porky11
comments.body:
This question doesn't make sense to me.

You don't make a game in Astra.
If you let Astra make a game, or generally if you let an AI coding agent make a game, applies for all models, not only Astra, it can work with Unreal Engine.
